svg.title: Mini: first USB installation
svg.desc: Download the complete image: ocean-usb.bin from a numbered Mini release. Open PowerShell in that file’s folder: File Explorer address bar → type powershell → Enter. Prepare the tool and find the board’s port: Create .flash-tools; check Device Manager for your COM number. Save a backup, then flash at 0x0: Use the complete USB image and your port; keep power connected. Restart and check the ocean: Try touch controls; keep it running for at least 30 seconds

g.text: Windows overview — follow the numbered guide for the actual commands.
ocean-usb.bin from a numbered Mini release
Open PowerShell in that file’s folder
File Explorer address bar → type powershell → Enter
Prepare the tool and find the board’s port
Create .flash-tools; check Device Manager for your COM number
Save a backup, then flash at 0x0
Use the complete USB image and your port; keep power connected
Try touch controls; keep it running for at least 30 seconds
USB data cable required. Later updates: Settings → Check for Updates.
